newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney ups Ascend.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney ups Ascend.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Therese Murphy said she upgraded Ascend Communications Inc to a buy from neutral and boosted her 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates and target price on the company.
-- The analyst said she raised her 1997 calendar year earnings estimate to $1.57 per share from $1.46 previously and to $2.12 from $1.85 per share for 1998.
-- She raised her price target to $93. Her previous price target was not available immediately.

-- Murphy said her optimism about the stock reflected the continuing strength of the remote data communications market, both in terms of leased lines and dial-up access products used by telecommuters, remote sales forces and Internet users.

-- She said Ascend's two new product lines, the MAX TNT concentrator, a kind of switchboard for incoming Internet calls designed to be installed at telco carrier offices, and its GRF 400 product, which is designed to reduce Internet congestion, "are going to ramp sooner than I had expected."

-- Murphy said she expected Ascend to begin recognizing revenues from volume shipments this month for its MAX TNT product and for it to begin seeing "meaningful" revenues on its GRF 400 line in the June quarter.
